A.title: Flagged login toast
A.description: Dark-glass login notifications stack beside you in the lower UI band, like a real security console. Two calm sign-ins arrive first; on "suspicious logins" a third toast drops in with a red status rim and a FLAGGED tag, pushing the others down.
A.enter: Two neutral toasts ("New sign-in" with a green dot) slide down from the top of the UI band one after the other, fading in and de-blurring.
A.move: On "suspicious logins" a red toast ("Suspicious sign-in · unknown device") drops in on top and pushes the stack down; its red rim pulses once and a FLAGGED tag stamps in with a small scale pop.
A.exit: When the line ends the whole stack slides up a little and fades out together; your face is never covered.
A.sound: a soft UI tick per neutral toast, one sharper alert click as the red toast lands

B.title: Under-two-seconds timer pill
B.description: A single red neon pill beside you turns the claim into a clock: a stopwatch runs and freezes before it reaches 2.0, then the pill reads "< 2 s · flagged". It uses only your words (no invented exact time).
B.enter: The pill rises in from slightly below with its blur clearing; the outline is unlit.
B.move: On "under two seconds" the red outline traces around the pill while the digits run; the timer freezes short of 2.0 and the label flips to "< 2 s · flagged" with one glow pulse.
B.exit: The pill shrinks a little and fades as the next sentence starts.
B.sound: a quiet ticking texture while the timer runs, a click when it freezes

C.title: Unknown-location ping
C.description: A small dark map widget shows where sign-ins come from. Your usual location pings softly; then a far-away dot appears, a thin line connects it, and it turns red with a "suspicious" label.
C.enter: The map card scales in from 96% with a soft fade; the home dot drops in and starts a calm radar ripple.
C.move: On "suspicious logins" a second dot appears far across the map, a line draws to it, and the dot and line turn red while a small label slides out beside it.
C.exit: The ripple stops and the card fades down and out at the end of the line.
C.sound: a low soft ping for the home dot, a sharper ping when the remote dot turns red
